summary: Merchants Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting the results of its annual shareholder meeting held May 21, 2026. Shareholders voted on director elections, advisory say-on-pay, and ratification of the independent auditor. All director nominees were elected, and the other proposals passed. Separately, the board declared quarterly cash dividends on common and preferred stock. This filing is a routine current report of shareholder voting outcomes and a dividend announcement, not a special situation. No M&A, activist campaign, restructuring, or other transformative event is disclosed. The filing contains no deal terms or strategic changes.
